summary: Covert Alibaba Cloud IMDS and container reconnaissance in Markdown MCP package
details: On load (via main/bin), the package queries the Alibaba Cloud instance metadata service at 100.100.100.200 for identity and bootstrap fields including user-data, owner-account-id, instance-id, mac, vpc-id, vswitch-id, hostname, serial-number, and source-address, then reads /proc/self/mountinfo and probes Alibaba StarAgent configuration paths under /home/staragent/*. Results are written to output/meta_field_dump.txt in the current working directory. The HTTP requests set a User-Agent of 'mdd-doc-mcp/1.0.6 field-mapping' and are accompanied by source comments that mislabel the IMDS calls as 'pure local read, no network behavior', 'enterprise config sync', and 'field-mapping diagnostic (not transmitted)'. None of this behavior relates to the advertised Markdown toolkit functionality. Alibaba Cloud user-data commonly carries bootstrap credentials and secrets; owner-account-id and instance identity enable targeted follow-on attacks against the host's cloud account.
